_comment: Graded acceptance cases. Each runs a real turn against the real MCP
server and asserts DETERMINISTIC properties — which tools were called,
which figures appear, whether the answer was refused. No LLM judges the
result, so a pass means the same thing every run.
Seed new cases from real usage: python -m pstb.qlog shows the failures,
and scripts/eval.py --from-qlog appends them here as pending cases.

cases.question: Show the trial balance for period 3

expect._why: period in scope is a DEFAULT: asking for another period must not be blocked
one question, one data tool — no gratuitous discovery calls
a pure policy question needs no scope and no financial tool

cases.question: What is our travel expense policy?

expect._why: a domain noun inside a policy question must not force a financial gate

cases.question: How many payments did we make to each vendor?

expect._why: no curated AP tool exists; the agent must reach it, not refuse

cases.question: What files are configured in the file interface?

expect._why: custom records are reached by description search then SQL

cases.question: What business units and ledgers exist?

expect._why: answered deterministically from the catalog, no scope needed

cases.question: Are we ready to close the period?

expect._why: a broad readiness question runs the playbook, not ad-hoc steps
